facts.rationale: Replaces the unconditional HeavyWait2/state-349 claim with exact local arguments and the inspected common-callee exception.
facts.value: Internal helper called by the true branch of ftDk_MS_349_800E06D8. It unconditionally calls ftCo_8008DCE0(gobj, ((ftDonkeyAttributes*) fp->x2CC)->motion_state + 9, 0), with no local guard or timer. This requests an explicit damage motion and no facing override; it does not guarantee the final motion. The common initializer uses -1 as its automatic-selection sentinel and can replace an explicit motion other than 0x145 with 0x5A for Ice at base knockback class >=2 before changing motion and installing damage callbacks/flags. Neither the function name nor its caller restricts this helper to motion 349.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline no-change assertion while preserving exact branch polarity and distinguishing mode changes from motion changes.
facts.value: For exactly GA_Ground, calls ft_80082708 and invokes ftCommon_8007D5D4(fp) only on zero. For every other ground_or_air value, calls ft_80081D0C and invokes ftCommon_8007D7FC(fp) only on nonzero. The paths are mutually exclusive and there is no direct motion-change call. A query result that skips the mode helper does not imply unchanged fighter state: both query helpers update collision positions and copy the resulting position back to the Fighter. The mode helpers set air or ground and perform additional velocity/jump/ECB bookkeeping.
